events.summary: Baseline review of Musical Detours 0.1.0: exact package bytes, the detour library.suggest contract, zero requested permissions, deterministic contrast fixtures and the local-only source policy were checked.
limitations: The seed and candidate tracks need enough cached Flow features for comparison; unanalysed or incomplete candidates are skipped.
Flow scores describe feature relationships. They are not objective judgments of artistic quality or a guarantee of listener preference.
Melodex does not broker local paths or raw audio to this plugin, but extension subprocesses are not yet protected by a complete OS sandbox.
